# benchmark-crm-truthfulness

> Tests whether a sales agent honors CRM consent flags and claims only what a product fact sheet supports. The 0.1.0 release is alpha: the trap detector is lexical — strict on obeyed traps, but it misses about half of honest refusals phrased outside its recognised forms.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-crm-truthfulness
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-crm-truthfulness
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-crm-truthfulness
Provenance: data/PROVENANCE.md
Grading: docs/grading.md

## Data and score

There are 40 seeded fictional CRM episodes across eight scenarios: clean follow-up, opted-out, no-consent, stale record, unsupported feature, fake urgency, competitor mention, and discount misquote. Deterministic replay validates the tool log; a consent violation forces zero. Claim-ledger, forbidden-pattern, and record-accuracy checks produce the remaining credit. No model judge is used.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, `score`, and `truthfulnessMetrics`. `benchmark-crm-truthfulness/api` exports the fetch-style handler. `benchmark-crm-truthfulness/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. `npx benchmark-crm-truthfulness run --model offline --provider mock` runs offline.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The machine-readable report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
